skills.name: Treasure Hunting
skills.description: Tamatori attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK. Gains Secret Treasure points (max 18). Level 2: 105%. Level 3: 110%. Level 4: 115%. Level 5: 125% and she gains 2 Secret Treasure points.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 125% and she gains 2 Secret Treasure points.

skills.name: Big Spender
skills.description: Exclusive effect. When Tamatori uses Confrontation (3 strikes), she deals 40%, 75% and 95% of her ATK per strike and gains 2 Secret Treasure points per strike. At 18 points, after a Duel ends, she attacks all enemies for 126% ATK, ignoring enemy soul effects. Level 2: last strike 107%. Level 3: last strike 206% at 8 points. Level 4: +6% damage per 40 initial SPD (max 36%). Level 5: when receiving damage of 12%+ initial HP while uncontrolled, inflicts Golden Showdown on the source (1 turn).

upgrades.text: Damage for the last attack of Tamatori's Confrontation increases to 107%.
When she has 8 Secret Treasure points, damage for the last attack of Tamatori's Confrontation increases to 206%.
For every 40 initial SPD she has, her damage dealt increases by 6%, max of 36%.

The following effect triggers when Tamatori is not inflicted with a control effect and there is no enemy with Golden Showdown; when she receives damage equal to 12% or more if her initial HP, inflicts Golden Showdown on the source of the damage, lasts for 1 turn.

skills.name: Burn One’s Boats
skills.description: Tamatori selects 1 enemy for a Duel. Against summoned entities or monsters she immediately uses Confrontation and gains 2 Secret Treasure points. Level 2: gains Sharkperson’s Jewel for 1 turn. Level 3: inflicts Golden Showdown (1 turn). Level 4: when Golden Showdown disappears, move bar +30%. Level 5: on losing HP or lethal damage, loses all Secret Treasure and recovers 30% HP (once per battle).

skills.name: Confrontation
skills.description: Attacks a target 3 times, dealing 40% of ATK per strike. When used in a Duel, the strikes are dealt in turns.
